meta.name: English
meta.note: Translators: copy this file to lang/<code>.json (tr, de, ...) and translate the values only. Keep keys and {placeholders}. Missing keys fall back to English. Command words in 'cmd' are added to the English ones.

intro: Year 2031. A megacorp hides a secret project called Zero Day on vault.lab. The way in runs through its network. Put on headphones: sounds come from the left and right ear.
Your goal: download core.dat from vault.lab. Every move leaves a trace. The ticking you hear is your trace level: the faster it ticks, the closer they are. At 100 percent you are caught.
Type help for commands. Start with: scan
help: Commands: scan, connect <name>, disconnect, ports, exploit <port>, crack, tune, ls, read <file>, get <file>, wipe, status, shop, buy <item>, inv, use <item>, voice on/off, vol 0-10, quit.
Tips: old software has holes. Some locks need an exploit first. Read the files for clues. Not every server is what it seems.
Tone lock: keys 1 to 4, R replays. Frequency lock: A and D move the dial. Firewall during a download: A for the left ear, D for the right ear.

ui.denied: Access denied. Take over the server first.
ui.no_node: I don't know that server. Use scan.
ui.conn_ok: Connected to {name}. No access yet. Type ports to listen for services.
ui.conn_root: Connected to {name}. You have admin access.
ui.port_closed: That port is closed. Wasted time.
ui.x_ok: Port {p} exploited! The service crashed and the door is open.
ui.x_fail: That service is up to date. The attack failed and security noticed.
ui.trap: ALARM! This was a trap and the alarms are going off.
ui.no_lock: No such lock on this server.
ui.need_x: You cannot reach the lock yet. Exploit a vulnerable service first.
ui.simon_intro: Tone lock: listen to {n} tones. Tone 1 is lowest and in the left ear, tone 4 is highest and in the right ear. Then repeat the sequence with keys 1 to 4. R replays it for 2 trace.
ui.simon_fail: Wrong tone. The lock reset. Type crack to try again.
ui.simon_auto: Your decoder solved the tone lock.
ui.tune_intro: Frequency lock: press A or D to move the dial. The ping comes from the side where the signal is, and gets higher in pitch as you get closer. You have 14 tries.
ui.tune_fail: Out of tries. The lock reset. Type tune to try again.
ui.newnode: A new server appeared: {name}. Use scan.
ui.vault_open: Both keys collected. vault.lab just appeared on the network!
ui.dl_start: Download started. If you hear a warning in one ear, press A for left or D for right. Be quick.
ui.dl_other: Downloaded. It is not the target, but it is worth {cr} credits.
ui.win: MISSION COMPLETE! You have the target file and got out. Rank: {rank}. Trace {t}, commands used {n}, credits {cr}.
ui.lose: TRACED. The connection is cut and the mission has failed. Game over.
ui.own: You already have that and it is active.
ui.ev_admin: An admin just logged in nearby!
ui.ev_patrol: A security scan swept the network.
ui.ev_lucky: A colleague sends you a small bonus for good work. 15 credits.
ui.voice_on: Voice on. Turn off your screen reader if it reads twice.
ui.restart_q: Press Enter to play again, Ctrl+C to quit.
ui.pick: Type the number of a mission and press Enter:
ui.v_target: No file is marked as the target. Write the word target as the third part of one file line.
ui.v_x: {name}: the exploit port is not one of its services.
ui.v_c: {name}: the tone lock length must be 0, or from 3 to 8.
ui.v_lock: {name} has no lock. Give it an exploit port, a frequency lock or a tone lock, or make it a trap.
ui.v_needs: {name} would never appear. Say which servers must be taken over first.
ui.v_goal: The target file can never be reached.
ui.dl_none: Downloaded. It is not the target.

notes: Admin memo: mail.local uses a tone lock instead of passwords. Our intranet still runs ancient software. DO NOT touch archive.net, it is the honeypot we set up for intruders.
log: 03:12 tunnel opened between mail.local and intra.corp. vault.lab needs keys from both.

inbox: Subject: vault.lab. The database there was never updated. You need an exploit, then a frequency lock, then a six tone lock.
mbox: Three years of boring emails. A buyer might pay for it.

wiki: Frequency locks: the ping comes from the side of the correct signal and gets higher as you get closer.
pay: Salaries of everyone. Sell it to the highest bidder.

core: Project Zero Day. 48 MB. This is it.

gui.title: Zero Day
gui.ms_list: Saved missions (select one to edit it):
gui.ms_intro: Story at the start (what the player hears first, one paragraph per line):
gui.ms_start: Server the player sees at the start:
gui.ms_saved: Mission saved. It is in the mission list at the start of the next game.
gui.ms_noname: Please give the mission a name.
gui.ms_nodel: This mission is built in and cannot be deleted.
gui.sv_ports: Services, one per line: port, name, version and year. Example: 21 ftp vsftpd 2.3.4 (2011). Old versions are weak, new ones are safe:
gui.sv_x: Weak service port to exploit (0 means no exploit lock):
gui.sv_tune: Frequency lock (the player uses the tune command)
gui.sv_c: Tone lock length (0 means no tone lock, otherwise 3 to 8):
gui.sv_pay: Credits the player earns for taking over this server:
gui.sv_trap: This server is a trap (attacking it raises trace a lot)
gui.sv_needs: This server appears after the player takes over (check all that apply; the start server needs none):
gui.sv_files: Files, one per line, written as: file name | text | optional part. The optional part is a number of credits for selling the file, or the word target for the file that wins the game. Do not use the | sign inside the text:
gui.sv_select: Select a server in the list first.
gui.sv_bad_port: This line does not start with a port number: {line}
gui.sv_noname: Please give the server a name.
gui.tr_new: Your translation ({lang}). Keep any word in curly braces, like {name}, exactly as it is. Leave it empty to keep the original text:
gui.tr_same: First choose the language you want to translate into, in the field Language you are writing in.
gui.tl_code: Language code, for example tr, de or fr:
gui.tl_bad: Please type a language code of two or three letters. It cannot be en.
gui.tl_saved: Saved. The game texts are in lang/{code}.json, and translated missions are saved in the missions folder next to the program. Restart the game to use the new language. It is chosen automatically when your Windows language matches.
gui.tr_ph: The translation has a word in curly braces that the original does not have: {ph}. Please fix it.
gui.tt_cmd: Extra command words in your language, separated by commas (optional, leave empty to keep the English commands only)

intro_tip: Every move leaves a trace. The ticking you hear is your trace level: the faster it ticks, the closer you are to being detected. At 100 percent the mission fails.
Type help for commands. Start with: scan
